TinfoilAssist v1.3.1

A hardened WebView wrapper for Tinfoil Chat (chat.tinfoil.sh).

Privacy features:
• Timezone spoofing (IANA-aware, DST-correct)
• Hardware fingerprint spoofing (CPU, RAM, GPU)
• WebRTC, sensor, battery & geolocation blocking
• iframe.contentWindow leak coverage
• Domain whitelist + OAuth block (Google/Microsoft/Apple)
• HTTPS-only mode, DNT, desktop User-Agent

Anti-fingerprinting ported from testAssist (github.com/taboia872/testAssist),
based on deafenken/notme.

Original WebView structure from gptassist by @woheller69 and
geminiAssist by @AcideFluorhydrique.

Built by vibe coding — IA wrote the code, a human directed the strategy.
